# enom_domain_nameservers (Resource)

Manages the nameservers for an eNom domain registration. This resource updates the nameservers on an existing domain — it does not register or delete domains.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_name` (String) The domain name to manage, e.g. "fileblaze.com".
- `nameservers` (List of String) List of nameservers to assign to the domain (minimum 2, maximum 13).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The domain name (used as the resource identifier).
